dataset: Stanford Dogs Dataset (Khosla, Jayadevaprakash, Yao, Fei-Fei; FGVC Workshop, CVPR 2011)
independent_checksum_match: sha256 and size equal to tensorflow_datasets/datasets/stanford_dogs/checksums.tsv (GitHub, master)
retrieval_note: Local DNS returned NXDOMAIN for vision.stanford.edu; the host was resolved via DNS-over-HTTPS (Cloudflare and Google both: CNAME ai.stanford.edu -> 171.64.68.10) and fetched over plain HTTP, the scheme used by the official page link (HTTPS on that IP presents a certificate for another name). Authenticity is supported by the independent TFDS checksum match.
extraction_checks: regular files only, no absolute paths, no '..', single path component, tarfile filter='data'
images_and_annotations: pre-existing local copies in data/images/Images and data/annotations/Annotation; not re-downloaded, not modified
terms: The official page (checked 2026-10-13) gives authors and citations but no explicit license; it states the dataset was built from ImageNet images and annotations. ImageNet's terms of access (non-commercial research/educational use) were NOT re-verified in this project. Images are not redistributed by this repository.
citation: Aditya Khosla, Nityananda Jayadevaprakash, Bangpeng Yao and Li Fei-Fei. Novel dataset for Fine-Grained Image Categorization. First Workshop on Fine-Grained Visual Categorization (FGVC), CVPR 2011. Secondary: J. Deng et al., ImageNet: A Large-Scale Hierarchical Image Database. CVPR 2009.
